name: SkyFactory 5
summary: Guess who's back?! Back again for it's 5th installment! That's right, it's SkyFactory 5! View the world in a way you never have before with all new, unprecedented, handmade modpack progression. Your goal is to paint the world one color at a time with whatever happy accidents happen along the way! Filled with tech, magic, chaos, and imagination you'll create your magnum opus that will leave an everlasting impression.
